title: Braking time correct
description: Essential: The student's answer for the braking time must be 4 seconds.

title: Resistance force magnitude
description: Essential: The student's answer for the magnitude of the resistance force must be 2.5 × 10³ N.

title: Waiting time calculation
description: Essential: The student's answer for the waiting time must be 20 seconds.

title: Final speed at crosswalk
description: Essential: The student's answer for the car's speed at the crosswalk in part (3) must be 5√5 m/s.

title: Unit conversion applied
description: Important: The solution correctly converts velocities from km/h to m/s for use in kinematic equations.

title: Correct kinematic equations
description: Important: The solution uses appropriate uniformly accelerated motion equations (e.g., v² = u² + 2as) for parts (1) and (3).

title: Child crossing time logic
description: Important: For part (2), the solution correctly calculates the total time for the line of children to cross as (road width + line length) / child's speed.

title: Sign error in acceleration
description: Pitfall: The solution incorrectly uses a positive sign for the braking acceleration or force when it should be negative (deceleration).

title: Incorrect distance in part (3)
description: Pitfall: The solution incorrectly uses the braking distance or acceleration from part (1) in the calculation for part (3), without recalculating for the new initial speed.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: The solution demonstrates unit analysis or includes units consistently in intermediate steps.
